stem_md: 设曲线积分 $\int_Lxy^2\,dx+y\varphi(x)\,dy$ 与路径无关，其中 $\varphi$ 有连续导数且 $\varphi(0)=0$，求从 $(0,0)$ 到 $(1,1)$ 的积分值（ ）
analysis_md:
解析：

$$P(x,y)=xy^2，\quad Q(x,y)=y\varphi(x)，\quad \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(xy^2)=2xy，\quad \frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}[y\varphi(x)]=y\varphi'(x).$$

因积分与路径无关 $\Rightarrow \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}$，

由 $y\varphi'(x)=2xy\Rightarrow \varphi(x)=x^2+C$

由 $\varphi(0)=0$，知 $C=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad \varphi(x)=x^2.$

故 $\int_{(0,0)}^{(1,1)}xy^2\,dx+y\varphi(x)\,dy=\int_0^1 0\,dx+\int_0^1 y\,dy=\frac{1}{2}$

$$P(x,y)=xy^2，\quad Q(x,y)=y\varphi(x)，\quad \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(xy^2)=2xy，\quad \frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}[y\varphi(x)]=y\varphi'(x).$$
